title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England submits for review and approval an Extension Agreement to a 365-Day Firm Transportation Agreement with Kraft Foods Global, Inc.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department APPROVES the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms fo the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul J. Hibbard, Chariman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating and Tim Woolf. (DPU O7-GC-11)
